message.content:
An editorial illustration for "TEMPO" magazine features two side-by-side caricature portraits of the same man with black hair and glasses. The figure on the left is shown from the chest up, wearing a light-colored, short-sleeved button-down shirt with a pocket containing a pen and a small card. His expression is stern. The figure on the right is also shown from the chest up, wearing a bright red suit jacket over a white shirt and a grey-and-red striped tie. A circular black pin with a red bull graphic is pinned to his lapel. This figure has a slight smirk.

Large, bold black text in the center reads "DUA WAJAH AHOK." Above the word "TEMPO," smaller text reads "PANIK HARGA DAGING" and "SETYA NOVANTO TENTANG JOKOWI," separated by a diagonal line. Below "TEMPO" is the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU." The bottom-left corner contains a barcode, the date "13-19 JUNI 2016," the price "RP 39.500," and "WWW.TEMPO.CO." The background is a flat, solid grey. Red borders frame the left and bottom edges of the cover.
